text:
elaine_pm: Heads up — finalizing SmartServe launch criteria. Need cross-team alignment on sequencing & resourcing. Major deps: runtime batching (target p95 <= 100ms), infra quota & routing, security review for data plane, and QE signoff. Proposing canary -> scale -> GA over ~3 weeks. Who can own what? cc @taylor-runtime @sam-infra @emily-sec @sophie-qa

taylor-runtime: I can own runtime changes. ETA: 2 sprints for batching perf + CI tests. Need a prod-like perf harness and access to dedicated GPUs. Can we get infra for a perf lab? @sam-infra :eyes:

sam-infra: We can provision a perf lab GPU pool (2x A100) next week if you give me the exact configs. Also need expected QPS and peak tokens/sec. Share workload profile.

taylor-runtime: Quick profile: baseline qps ~1200 (short requests), ~250 peak long-streaming. Token distribution skewed to 20-800 tokens. Prod profile link (internal): https://redwood.internal/docs/smartserve/profiles (placeholder).

emily-sec: Security review scope: threat model + data flows + KMS plan + key rotation. If docs are in by EOD Thu we can do a rapid review and sign off by Tue. Any PCI/PHI in the payloads? Also need IAM mapping for cross-region fallback.

sophie-qa: QE can run the canary tests and perf smoke. Need: test plan, sample prompts, failure thresholds, and automated rollback hooks for canary failures. Do we have SLIs defined?

mike-eng: Product note: our beta customer (Acme) expects GA end-of-month. We should be explicit on must-have vs nice-to-have for GA — recommend cutting noncritical observability fields from GA if they slow path.

elaine_pm: Proposed minimal launch checklist + owners (draft):
```
- Week 0: Runtime batching gated (owner: taylor-runtime) -> perf harness + unit tests
- Week 1: Infra perf lab + routing policy (owner: sam-infra) -> allocate 2xA100 pool
- Week 1: Security rapid review (owner: emily-sec) -> threat model + KMS plan
- Week 2: QE canary + rollback automation (owner: sophie-qa)
- Week 3: Gradual scale -> GA (owner: elaine_pm / mike-eng)
```
Please call out anything we should deprioritize for GA.

deploy-bot: schedule created: canary_start=1794002000, canary_end=1794002600, ga_target=1794003600 :shipit:

sam-infra: Acknowledged. I'll open infra PR with terraform snippet and perf-lab request. @taylor-runtime, ping me the exact model + quant flags and desired networking (VPC/subnet).

taylor-runtime: Sending model cfg: `model=redwood-13b-optimized`, `quant=8bit`, `batch_size=64`, `kv_cache=enabled`. Will attach perf harness repo link in the ticket.

elaine_pm: Thanks all. Action items updated in the roadmap task. Sync Tuesday 9:00am PT to confirm final cut for GA. If anyone has calendar conflicts DM me. :white_check_mark:
